item.title: Label a Herb Box for a Friend
item.prompt_text: The box has mint on the left and basil on the right. Ask your friend to water both on Monday and Thursday. The watering can is under the shelf. Write a card to leave next to the box.
item.audience: your friend who will look after a balcony box
item.target_grammar: On the left and on the right. Use please before a command.
item.target_structure: Label the two sides, give the days, and say where the can is.

checklist.point: Tell the friend where to find the watering can.
